creator.lead_magnet.facts:
Check the top two inches of soil with a finger
Water until it runs out the bottom
Empty the saucer after 15 minutes
Water less in winter
Bright light means more water

creator.newsletter.main: why my pothos finally stopped yellowing
creator.newsletter.story: It was the pot. No drainage hole, so the roots sat in water for weeks. I moved it into a nursery pot inside the pretty one and it put out two new leaves in a month.
creator.newsletter.tip: Lift your pot after watering. If it feels heavy days later, wait.
